newsitem.title: USA: Thieves nabbed hiding in Miami toy shop ceiling.
newsitem.headline: Thieves nabbed hiding in Miami toy shop ceiling.

text.p: It is not only the man with a white beard and red suit who drops from the rooftop at Christmas in Miami -- two men allegedly planning to raid a toy store were caught hiding in an air conditioning duct in the ceiling.

The men were waiting for the Toys R Us store to close on Monday so they could rifle the tills and rob the employees, police said on Tuesday. But they were talking so loudly they were overheard by employees who called police.
The two were found in the ceiling with guns, wirecutters, ski masks, gloves, and flashlights. "It was a Christmas surprise for them," North Miami Beach Police Commander Alan Graham said.
